Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

Validation: name the checks actually run and their results. Record skipped or
blocked gates and known failures; a build does not prove title compatibility.

For guest behavior or upstream ports: link the issue, source commit/reviewed
regressions, relevant ADR, and tracking record. State affected title scope and
rollback. Do not include game files, generated game code, private captures,
user saves or restricted SDK material.
